items.title: USN-9150-1: SWUpdate vulnerabilities
items.summary: It was discovered that SWUpdate did not verify that a path was a directory before cleaning it up, leading to a race condition. items.title: USN-9149-1: MiniMagick vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that MiniMagick passed the file names and URLs given to Image.open directly to Kernel#open. If an application opened an image from an untrusted file name or URL, an attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary commands.

items.title: USN-9148-1: Mechanize vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that Mechanize used Kernel#open to open local files in several methods. If an application passed untrusted input as a local file name to one of these methods, an attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary commands.

items.title: USN-9147-1: PyWPS vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that PyWPS did not disable the resolution of XML external entities when parsing requests. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to read arbitrary files on the server.

items.title: USN-9146-1: Privoxy vulnerabilities
items.summary: Joshua Rogers discovered that Privoxy incorrectly handled memory allocation, leading to a memory leak. items.title: USN-9145-1: OAR vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that the oarsh script in OAR did not properly filter OpenSSH options. An authenticated user could possibly use this issue to obtain sensitive information or escalate privileges.

items.title: USN-9144-1: ngIRCd vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that ngIRCd incorrectly handled SERVER commands without a prefix, leading to an out-of-bounds read. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause ngIRCd to crash, resulting in a denial of service.

items.title: USN-9143-1: Mumble vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that the Murmur server in Mumble did not rate limit certain client messages. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause Murmur to hang or crash, resulting in a denial of service. items.summary: It was discovered that Apache XML Security for Java incorrectly passed a configuration property when creating specific key elements.
